name: @solidjs/size-scenarios
description: Tree-shaken import-cost tracking for #2883, bundled with Rolldown (what Vite ships). Deliberately OUTSIDE the pnpm workspace with its own npm lockfile: adding these dev tools to the workspace graph re-keys pnpm peer instances (vitest/@codspeed/vitest-plugin), which relocates the benchmark harness and produces phantom CodSpeed regressions. Rolldown is pinned exactly: its minifier decides the numbers, so an upgrade is a re-base, recorded like any other cap change.
